a3_provenance.caveat: 1 Wh quantum at ~85 W updates roughly every 42 s, so it cannot resolve a short run, and it never decreases inside a boot

a3_provenance.validity_condition: NONE PUBLISHED: the value arrives with no validity companion, so it cannot be qualified at all

a3_provenance.authentic_data_exists: YES for the raw operands; the derived column agrees with reported power inside quantisation
a3_provenance.caveat: a consistency check, never a replacement for the power register
a3_provenance.producer_field: not published by the device; host-side only
a3_provenance.validity_condition: both operands qualified and the frame is DRIVEN

a3_provenance.authentic_data_exists: YES: committed 600 s capture 108 -> 122 Wh (delta 14 Wh) against a 14.219 Wh trapezoidal integral of power
a3_provenance.caveat: the counter has no validity token; a 14 Wh delta carries a +-1 Wh quantum on each end, so 42 s of run time is the smallest interval it can speak about
a3_provenance.source_register: difference of input 0x0004..0x0005 across a run
a3_provenance.validity_condition: same boot_id, monotonic counter, run boundaries known

a3_provenance.authentic_data_exists: PARTIAL - one 600 s committed run at one duty level only

a3_provenance.caveat: a DC branch through an IBT-2 makes power factor meaningless anyway; the register was never read and no capture carries it

on_off_consistency.note: APPLIED_OFF_CURRENT_ABOVE_FLOOR frames are candidate anomalies only, and two explanations compete without this host tool choosing between them: the canonical safety class CONTROL_ELECTRICAL_ANOMALY (docs/01 22.4 'Commanded OFF + unexpected current' and 23.4 'current while state should be OFF', high severity), and the register-holdover reading in which the same values merely repeat the preceding driven frame. pwm_decision.no_shame_clause: docs/05A: 'No shame in NO-GO.' The energy-aware duty control is optional work; the core gates do not depend on it, and NOT_DECIDED is recorded as a defect of the parameter set, not of the plant.
pwm_decision.what_this_file_is: the METHODOLOGY. It deliberately does not decide Go, and it does not invent a threshold to make itself decidable.
why_not_go: 6 of 6 decision parameters are still UNRESOLVED: duty_readback_tolerance_permille, power_per_duty_slope_tolerance, hot_side_margin_k, component_temp_max_c, energy_resolution_floor_wh, fuse_coordination_verdict
safety preconditions not satisfied: PWM-P1, PWM-P2, PWM-P4, PWM-P5, PWM-P7, PWM-P8, PWM-P9
the delivered build cannot actuate at all (output stage compiled out, requested duty 0, actuator enable disallowed), so no criterion can be measured on it

reference_check.meter_evidence: no calibration record for the PZEM-017 and none for the 50 A / 75 mV shunt exists in this repository (the shunt was seen in a photo only, SOURCE VERIFIED, never calibrated)

resolution_limits.consequence: a 1 Wh counter and a 0.1 W register cannot resolve a short-run efficiency difference; only run-integral comparisons are meaningful

reference_check.what_would_close_it: one trusted reference meter (or a calibrated shunt channel) measured at several duty points against the PZEM, recorded in the same session
